Cusco · Perú

San Pedro Market

A covered market arranged by trade

Current ratingsOpening hoursView the place on the map
Nearby places

Explore

This covered market serves residents as well as travellers. Its aisles divide produce, prepared food and daily supplies. Looking along a whole aisle reveals that organisation better than stopping immediately at the first colourful display.

Planning your visit

30–60 min · Allow this time for the visit itself. Add travel, admission queues and any scheduled tour separately.

What to look for

A covered market arranged by trade

Look for the rhythm of a produce aisle from its end, keeping baskets and customers clear. With permission, focus on the ingredients that distinguish one stall from its neighbour.

Suggested visit

Admission
The public market has no museum ticket. Agree on price and portions with each stallholder before ordering.

Opening hours

Visit during active trading hours. Each stallholder decides when to open or close, so a meal plan should allow for changes.

Getting there

Walk from the historic centre to the address below. The last street can be pedestrian-only; give drivers the place name rather than just the district.

Get directions

History and local experience

Produce and prepared meals occupy different spaces and move at different speeds. Comparing an ingredient stall with a counter serving lunch connects the trading floor with Cusco’s daily cooking.

Walking route

  1. Mercado Central de San Pedro, calle Túpac Amaru, Cusco
  2. Enter from the side facing San Pedro church, select one aisle to walk to its end and return by another row.
  3. Ask the vendor before taking a close photograph of a stall or its staff.
